findings.rule: Tolerances tighter than a normal machining process can hold without specified GD&T or special process.
findings.reasoning: Dimension D21 specifies 20±0.02 mm (0.04 mm total tolerance) on feature F10, which is far tighter than the general machining tolerance of ±0.2 mm for the 6–30 mm range and typically requires grinding or precision boring. No surface finish symbol or GD&T frame is associated with this dimension to indicate the required special process, making it likely to be manufactured incorrectly or rejected at inspection.
findings.correction: Relax the tolerance on D21 to match standard machining capability (e.g., ±0.1), or explicitly add a surface finish requirement and appropriate GD&T if the tight tolerance is functionally mandatory.

findings.rule: Functional holes left with no tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The two Ø15 holes (D5/F1) and two Ø8.4 holes (D9/F2) are called out without any tolerance or fit class. The Ø8.4 diameter strongly suggests clearance holes for M8 fasteners, but without a specified tolerance (e.g., H13) they default to the general machining tolerance of ±0.2 mm, which may result in an improper fit for the intended fasteners.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate hole tolerance or fit class to D5 and D9 (e.g., H13 for clearance holes) to ensure correct assembly with mating fasteners or pins.
